gloss: deep-fried skewered meat, seafood, or vegetables

definitions.explanation: Bite-sized pieces of meat, seafood, or vegetables skewered on sticks, coated in batter and breadcrumbs, and deep-fried. A specialty of Osaka's Shinsekai district.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}の{串|くし}カツは{二度漬|にどづ}け{禁止|きんし}だ。
examples.english: In Osaka, double-dipping is forbidden with kushikatsu.

examples.japanese: {新世界|しんせかい}の{串|くし}カツ{屋|や}で、{色|いろ}んな{種類|しゅるい}の{串|くし}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: At a kushikatsu restaurant in Shinsekai, I ordered various kinds of skewers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A signature dish of {大阪|おおさか}, especially the {新世界|しんせかい} district. The famous rule {二度漬|にどづ}け{禁止|きんし} (no double-dipping) means you must not dip a skewer into the communal sauce more than once — use a cabbage leaf to scoop extra sauce instead.

FORMS:
{串|くし} (skewer) + カツ (cutlet, from English "cutlet")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {串|くし}カツ{屋|や}: kushikatsu restaurant
- {串|くし}カツ{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ: assorted kushikatsu platter
- {二度漬|にどづ}け{禁止|きんし}: no double-dipping
